newsitem.title: FINLAND: Nokia surge punches post-Fed Helsinki to new highs.
newsitem.headline: Nokia surge punches post-Fed Helsinki to new highs.

text.p: A Fed decision to leave key U.S. rates steady whipped shares up again to new all-time highs on Wednesday, with Nokia punching through resistance: but despite solid volume brokers wondered when the turn would come.

"This is so bullish, it cannot go on very long," said one. The HEX rose 2.06 percent to 3,097.71 -- putting its performance so far this year at 24 percent -- in hefty volume at nearly 900 million markka, almost half of it in bellwhether Nokia.
After several recent half-hearted attempts, Nokia finally smashed through resistance at 340 markka to close at a new all-time high of 348.00, up 12.90 markka or nearly four percent.
The FOX index was up 1.89 percent at a 1,074-point record close after hitting 1,075.66 points intra-day.

Engineering group Rauma rose sharply after UPM priced its offering at 113.50 markka, closed its retail tranche books due to oversubscription, and Rauma said it was buying one million of its own shares. It closed up 5.90 markka at 120.90.
Food and chemicals group Raisio rose 15.00 markka to 415.00 after saying it would create a separate business unit for its Benecol margarine to enable growth.
Forestries were helped by an ongoing upturn in pulp prices, but although the index probed new highs it lagged the market.
